metadata.question: Did did the total rainfall exceed 8 inches in Canberra, Australia during January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about total rainfall in Canberra, Australia during January 14-22, 2020, specifically if it exceeded 8 inches. 1. Search strategy: - Collection: GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) data would be appropriate for rainfall - Dataset: NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06 - this provides global precipitation data - Date range: 2020-01-14 to 2020-01-22 - Location: Canberra, Australia - I'll create a point geometry 2. Masking strategy: - For precipitation data, I don't need to mask clouds since we're measuring rainfall itself - The precipitation band should be used directly 3. Logic: - Sum the precipitation over the date range - Convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) - Check if total > 8 inches - Need to check for empty collection and valid pixels Let me structure this: - Use GPM IMERG data which has 'precipitationCal' band in mm/hour - Sum over the time period to get total mm - Convert to inches - Compare to 8 inches ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var canberra = ee.Geometry.Point([149.1300, -35.2809]); // Canberra coordinates var startDate = '2020-01-14'; var endDate = '2020-01-22'; // 2. Data Acquisition - GPM precipitation data var precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(canberra); var colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); print(`GPM Images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { print("No precipitation data found for the period."); print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over the period var totalPrecip = precipCol.select('precipitationCal').sum(); // 4. Calculate total rainfall in the area var stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: canberra, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var meanPrecip = stats.get('precipitationCal'); // Get pixel count to check for valid data var countStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: canberra, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var pixelCount = countStats.get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); var precipValue = meanPrecip.getInfo(); print(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); print(`Total precipitation (mm): ${precipValue ? precipValue.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { print("No valid precipitation pixels."); print("C2"); return; } if (precipValue === null || precipValue === undefined || isNaN(precipValue)) { print("Invalid precipitation calculation."); print("C3"); return; } // Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) var precipInches = precipValue / 25.4; print(`Total precipitation (inches): ${precipInches.toFixed(2)}`); // 5. Final Answer if (precipInches > 8) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
